podcast.body: This 1991 song from Bikini Kill demonstrates the band's attitude and pioneering sound, featuring radical feminist politics and hard music. It was performed at the Love Rock Revolution Girl Style event, showcasing the band's early influential work. "Bikini Kill from 1991 with Suck My Left One."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song is featured on Bikini Kill's self-released 1991 demo album, "Revolution Girl Style Now." "This is from their 1991 demo album, Revolution Girl Style Now. It's called Suck My Left One."
